test_mpc_rank: test the crypten multiprocess context to verify process ranks are returned correctly
test_mpc_world_size: test the crypten multiprocess context to verify world size across ten processes
test_mpc_generator: test the crypten PRZS RNG generators are set up with different seeds per process

test_mpc_args_kwargs: test that args and kwargs are correctly forwarded through the multiprocess decorator
